controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Relative to 2019, estimated cumulative Structural Cost Savings totaled $16.3 billion, which included an additional $1.2 billion in the first six months of 2026." (le 10-Q T1 2026 disait 15,6 Mds $)
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : 16,3 Mds $ d'économies structurelles cumulées depuis 2019 au 30 juin 2026. Le chiffre de 15,1 Mds $ correspond au cumul fin 2025, antérieur à la date d'arrêté annoncée (3 août 2026).

controles.affirmation: Contentieux climatiques : des États et collectivités poursuivent ExxonMobil, la société juge l'issue défavorable 'remote'
controles.verbatim_source: ...have filed a number of legal proceedings against several oil and gas companies, including ExxonMobil, requesting unprecedented legal and equitable relief for various alleged injuries purportedly connected to climate change... we believe the likelihood is remote that the ultimate outcomes of these lawsuits will have a material adverse effect... (10-Q T2 2026, Note 7)

controles.affirmation: Le 31 juillet 2026, accord de règlement avec l'État de Louisiane et ses paroisses côtières sur l'érosion des marais, impact inclus dans les réserves financières du T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Effective July 31, 2026, the Corporation entered into a settlement with the state of Louisiana and the relevant coastal parishes settling all claims related to these matters. The settlement is not material to the Corporation, with estimated earnings impacts included in the second quarter financial reserve updates and third quarter earnings impacts expected to be immaterial.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le filing précise aussi que le règlement 'does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing, and does not provide for any government sanctions'. Par ailleurs le filing ne chiffre pas ce règlement ; la parenthèse '(1 199 M$ de pertes en identified items Upstream)' juxtapose deux éléments que le document ne relie pas explicitement. Reformuler : 'inclus, sans montant communiqué, dans les mises à jour de réserves financières du T2'.

controles.affirmation: Le prix du brut a ajouté 4 650 M$ au résultat Upstream du T2 et les marges de raffinage 3 180 M$ à Energy Products ; la croissance propre (Guyane, Permian) n'a apporté que 1 140 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Price - Increased earnings by $4,650 million, on higher crude realizations... Advantaged Volume Growth - Increased earnings by $1,140 million, mainly driven by Guyana and Permian growth. / Margin - Increased earnings by $3,180 million from stronger refining margins.

controles.affirmation: Bénéfice net 4,2 Mds $ au T1 2026 (-46% sur un an) puis 14,5 Mds $ au T2 (+105%)
Gain de 2 560 M$ de mark-to-market favorable sur dérivés dans Energy Products au T2, Moyen-Orient -1 060 M$ Upstream et -310 M$ Energy Products au T2
controles.verbatim_source: Estimated Timing Effects - Increased earnings by $2,560 million, on favorable derivative mark-to-market impacts. / Middle East Volume - Decreased earnings by $1,060 million due to Middle East disruption impacts. / Middle East Volume - Decreased earnings by $310 million.

controles.affirmation: Identified items S1 2026 : -1 199 M$ Upstream, -1 886 M$ Energy Products, -83 M$ Chemical, -13 M$ Specialty, soit -3 181 M$ (17% du bénéfice net du semestre)
controles.verbatim_source: Identified Items - 2026 $(1,199) million loss from financial reserves (Upstream YTD) ; Identified Items - 2026 $(1,886) million loss due to impairments and supply disruptions in the Middle East preventing physical shipments associated with hedges (Energy Products YTD). Somme = 3 181 M$ ; 3181/18708 = 17,0%.

controles.affirmation: Moyen-Orient sur le semestre : -1 280 M$ Upstream et -460 M$ Energy Products ; production de gaz -17% au T2 (6 849 vs 8 219 Mcf/j)
controles.verbatim_source: Middle East Volume - Decreased earnings by $1,280 million (Upstream YTD) / Middle East Volume - Decreased earnings by $460 million (Energy Products YTD) / Net natural gas production available for sale, Worldwide 6,849 (T2 2026) vs 8,219 (T2 2025).

controles.affirmation: FCF T1 2026 de 2,2 Mds $ contre ~9,2 Mds distribués (4,9 rachats + 4,3 dividendes) ; S1 : 19,3 Mds FCF pour 18,6 Mds distribués
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : OCF 8 705 M$, additions to PP&E 6 470 M$ → FCF 2 235 M$ ; rachats T1 4 852 M$, dividendes T1 ~4 335 M$. 10-Q T2 2026 : OCF 6M 32 260, cash capex 12 974 → 19,3 Mds ; 'distributed $8.6 billion in dividends... and repurchased $10.0 billion of common stock'.

controles.affirmation: Plan de 20 Mds $ de rachats en 2026, conditionnel ('assuming reasonable market conditions') ; dette nette à 10,7% du capital
controles.verbatim_source: the Corporation stated that it expects share repurchases of $20 billion in 2026, assuming reasonable market conditions / The net debt to capital ratio was 10.7 percent at the end of the second quarter

controles.affirmation: Réserves prouvées 19,3 Mds bep fin 2025 (-3% sur un an), dont 36% non développées ; 1,0 Md bep déclassé en 2025 ; réserves non développées Australie/Émirats depuis plus de 5 ans
controles.verbatim_source: approximately 7.0 billion oil-equivalent barrels (GOEB)... This represents 36 percent of the 19.3 GOEB reported in proved reserves / Total proved reserves at December 31, 2024 ... 19,949 / the Corporation reclassified approximately 1.0 GOEB of proved undeveloped reserves which no longer met the SEC definition of proved reserves / Proved undeveloped reserves in Australia and the United Arab Emirates have remained undeveloped for five years or more

controles.affirmation: Rythme de production 2025 de 4,74 Mbep/j, soit environ 11 ans de réserves ; pic de 24,3 Mds bep fin 2018
controles.verbatim_source: Oil-equivalent production (thousands of oil-equivalent barrels daily) 4,736 (2025). 19 311 / (4,736 x 365) = 11,2 ans. Le pic 24,3 Mds bep FY2018 provient de la série kpis-haut Mettrik, pas du 10-K FY2025 (qui ne remonte qu'à 2023).

controles.affirmation: Verbatim 10-K : la récupération des réserves peut être affectée par 'government policies' et 'consumer preferences'
controles.verbatim_source: the timing and amount recovered can be affected by a number of factors including completion of development projects, reservoir performance, regulatory approvals, government policies, consumer preferences, and significant changes in crude oil and natural gas price levels.

controles.affirmation: Permian 1 600 kbep/j en 2025 (367 en 2020) ; Guyane régie par le Petroleum Activities Act 2023
controles.verbatim_source: Total production volumes averaged a record 1.6 Moebd in 2025, approximately 0.4 Moebd higher than the previous year (Permian, 10-K FY2025) / The Petroleum Activities Act 2023 authorizes the Government of Guyana to license and enter petroleum agreements
controles.correction_proposee: Le chiffre 367 kbep/j pour 2020 vient de la série Mettrik, pas du 10-K FY2025.

controles.affirmation: Amortissements et dépréciations 15 460 M$ au S1 2026 vs 11 803 M$ au S1 2025
Scores de risque 5/5 'Changement climatique et transition énergétique' et 'Prix des commodities', tendance en hausse
controles.verbatim_source: Aucun système de notation 1-5 n'existe dans le 10-K FY2025 ; ces scores proviennent de l'extraction interne Mettrik (src/data/v2-pipeline/xom.json).
controles.correction_proposee: L'ATT présente déjà ces scores comme issus du 'dossier de risques (issu du 10-K)' via Mettrik. Préciser explicitement qu'il s'agit d'une notation Mettrik dérivée du 10-K et non d'une notation publiée par ExxonMobil.
